NEITHER DID THIS REVIEW.' The descent is STRUCTURAL, not merely lexical: the resolved value's entries[4] carries no thisAuthorDidNOTReproduceIt leaf -- v5 replaced that leaf with reproductionStatusInV5, carrying the verification-status clause forward re-spelled from 'The independent review also did not verify it' (one review on record) through v4's 'NEITHER OF THE THREE INDEPENDENT REVIEWS VERIFIED IT' (three on record) to 'no reviewer has verified either' (unbounded), exactly the count-tracking descent B-EIR9-01 established for the corroboration sentence (NINETEEN -> TWENTY-THREE -> 25 -> 'the rest'). The lineage's uniform standard (B-EIR5-01, B-EIR7-01, B-EIR8-01, B-EIR9-01) is that a false sentence of record blocks while the cryptography stands. advisories.measured: The single set's from equals its value byte-exactly (verified), so the resolver's from-check still does real work: it binds v10 to v9's exact resolved value and would refuse any drift. The alternatives the corpus offers were measured, not assumed: (a) a zero-operation declaration is refused by check-completeness-v2.py's EMPTIED rule ('a derivation with no operations materialises no effective contract, so it is refused', verified in its declaration_refusal at dbe1e6955f66b0ccb032df115ca03fa780895b129b51fb39a49593581901bfb9), and under the reviewed check-completeness.py it is not recognised at all -- is_operation_list requires a non-empty list, so the block would silently fall back to key-name scoring, the exact CMP-IR-01 mode the derivation encoding exists to escape; (b) editing v9's reviewed bytes is prohibited by freeze section 7.2, which v10 cites correctly; (c) a standalone reissue would abandon the verified chain. A carrier operation is therefore the only shape that presents the same clean value under a corrected declaration while keeping the chain resolvable under both corpus instruments, and the disclosure -- a dedicated top-level operationIsValuePreserving field, the operation's why, and operationAccounting's changedLeaves 0 with whyNoChanges -- is loud, accurate and complete. This is not formalism gaming the resolver; it satisfies the resolver's real invariant. The shape is sound; the artifact fails for what its declaration SAYS (B-EIR10-01), not for what its operation DOES.
